finalText:
**Build's clean.** 0 errors now.

Two real bugs, not noise, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on link.
- [retryPolicy.js:6](src/net/retryPolicy.js:6) threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. The new config loader leaves flags unset instead of `false`, so this needed to treat "not true" as disabled.

The rest were just deprecation/dedupe log spam, left alone.

Next: nothing. Build passes with 8 harmless warnings, 0 errors.
